proposed_fix.description: Remove the network delay on checkoutservice's pod network interface, for example a tc/netem qdisc or chaos rule. Then verify that checkoutservice p50/p90 latency and inbound latency to emailservice and shippingservice return to the roughly 4ms baseline. If the source can't be found, roll-restart the checkoutservice pods.
